pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum equal-item token_delta across the target original's cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base roster under tiktoken 0.14.0, on 30 fresh target-mix focus welds.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and target 98d30bcc remains the live executable disputed-original replication route immediately before mint.
All 30 complete pairs are unique and exactly absent from every served prior test_set.
The site mix is frozen at 24 verb and 6 object-nominal cases, matching the target original's inferred 8/2 mix.
Each Ainglish arm becomes its comparator by replacing weld hyphens with spaces and no other edit.
The tokenizer roster and tiktoken 0.14.0 match the target; tiktoken is imported only after mint.
Every finite result is retained and filed once without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: identical clause with marker hyphens replaced by spaces

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes a count.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair on cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base. Average all 30 items equally per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the member span. Site means are diagnostic only because the target original has no registered stratum contract. File every finite result once.
manifest.population: 30 fresh complete focus-weld pairs with the target original's inferred 24/6 verb/object-nominal site mix
manifest.selection: All complete pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure and checked against every served prior test_set. The 80/20 verb/object site mix matches the ten-item target's eight verb-focus and two nominal-focus cases. Each comparator differs only by replacing every weld hyphen with a space, preserving all words, order and punctuation.
